methodological_deficiencies: Lack of formal multi-annotator blind review protocol
No calculation of inter-annotator agreement statistics (e.g., Cohen's Kappa or Fleiss' Kappa)
Heuristic rules rely on static string matching (e.g. searching for '/etc/passwd' or 'union select') which may miss subtle attack variants or context-dependent exploits
Single-reviewer subjective adjudication without independent blinded cross-verification
Original WAMM repository labeling intent and attack generation schema (CyShield R&D) not formally documented in peer-reviewed source literature
evidentiary_assessment.mandated_academic_statement: Potential label inconsistencies were identified during manual inspection; the exact dataset-wide label-noise rate has not been independently established.
evidentiary_assessment.dataset_preservation_policy: STRICT PRESERVATION — Original WAMM ground-truth labels remain untouched and unmodified in all benchmark artifacts.

sample_case_studies.finding: Both model and heuristic agree with WAMM ground truth.

Payload exhibits classic directory traversal syntax against /etc/passwd, but was cataloged under RCE in WAMM. Model classified as Directory Traversal. Illustrates taxonomy ambiguity between LFI and code execution.
Parameter name 'url' suggests SSRF vector, but argument is local file path traversal. Demonstrates multi-vector attack ambiguity.
